title: Scan test for a suffix of ones
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and $b$ a bit. For all natural numbers $r,p$ such that $|x|=p+r$, run the fixed advice-ones machine for $2r+3$ steps on the self-delimiting encoding of $x$ followed by the one-bit string $[b]$, starting in state $0$ with its input head at position $2p+1$. The resulting configuration is halted and its output is the one-bit string whose value is true exactly when $b$ is true and every bit of $x$ at an index $j$ with $p\le j<|x|$ is true.
caveat: The fixed advice-ones machine is not defined in the supplied statement; the claim is rendered in terms of its run and the explicitly supplied scan condition.
